decision: Builder check failed drop arrivals (5->4, 3->2 on base 0/1000). Doug 8:35 PM ET: send to the full official screen; the drop-ring set-total rule still decides there.
blocker: Drop-ring arrival totals lower on both sets. Every early release that changed a drop game killed its target before any drop was called (46-47 s); the lost arrivals are 150-235 s later in games that diverged. The behavior already never starts while a drop run/hold is possible. Closing the rest within this behavior means turning it off for most of the match. Needs a coordinator / Doug decision (the noise-calibration benchmark and the 7:55 PM ET set-total ruling are the context)
